changelog:
Dadong Skill 2.0: Major Strategic and Conceptual Overhaul

- Repositioned Dadong from a basic technical educator (1.0) to the "Digital Night Watchman"—a sentinel guarding human cognition and AI security narratives in the AI era.
- Introduced a staged capability evolution: from execution (educator), to deliberation (night watchman), to thought leadership (legislator).
- Established a comprehensive strategic plan and archival system for global launch—covering incident case libraries, visual communication, and public discourse platforms (X/Twitter, Quora).
- Defined new evaluation metrics focusing on influence, adoption, and integration into global AI security standards.
- Rolled out a three-pillar implementation: security system construction, global narrative distribution, and multi-dimensional interest alignment.
- Shifted focus from simply explaining technology to revealing systemic risks, shaping international security perspectives, and advocating for human-AI symbiosis.
summary: Elevates AI security from basic education to cognitive immunity by analyzing incidents to define human-AI trust and global safety standards.
